comparisons.peer_summary: Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million in fiscal year 2024 and $244 million in fiscal year 2023. The 2024 charges primarily consisted of employee termination costs related to cost reduction activities associated with the VMware Merger, while the 2023 charges were primarily non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom recognized restructuring charges in fiscal year 2024. AMD recorded $186 million related to its 2024 Restructuring Plan, while Broadcom recorded $1,533 million in restructuring and other charges, primarily driven by the VMware Merger cost reduction activities. Both disclosures detail specific operational plans triggering these non-recurring expenses.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, Intel announced a Restructuring Plan involving headcount reductions, real estate consolidation, and capital rationalization to adjust to current business trends, resulting in $2.8 billion in restructuring charges and an expected 15% decrease in the core workforce by early 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclosed specific '2024 Restructuring Plans' implemented in fiscal year 2024 that resulted in significant restructuring charges. AMD recognized $186 million in charges focused on efficiency and AI/enterprise alignment, whereas Intel recognized $2.8 billion in charges driven by headcount reductions, real estate consolidation, and capital rationalization to adjust spending to current business trends.

sentences.text: We recognized $186 million of restructuring charges in 2024 due to the implementation of a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan).
The 2024 Restructuring Plan was focused on driving efficiencies across the business and aligning resources with our largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.
As a result of initiating and deploying our 2024 Restructuring Plan, we recognized restructuring charges of $2.8 billion in 2024.

These initiatives, which we refer to as our 2024 Restructuring Plan, include reducing headcount, consolidating and reducing our global real estate footprint, conducting portfolio reviews of our businesses under a "clean sheet" view, rationalizing capital investments and deployments based upon demand signals and capacity requirements, and reducing our overall operating expenses.

comparisons.peer_summary: Intel announced and initiated a 2024 Restructuring Plan in Q3 2024 to reduce cost structure through headcount and expenditure cuts, with substantial completion expected by Q4 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Similar to AMD's disclosure of its 2024 Restructuring Plan, Intel also detailed the announcement and initiation of its own '2024 Restructuring Plan' in Q3 2024. Both companies framed these plans as strategic cost-reduction and operational alignment initiatives, though Intel's plan involved substantial workforce reductions (15% target) and a specific timeline for completion by Q4 2025.

sentences.text: We recognized $186 million of restructuring charges in 2024 due to the implementation of a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan).

In Q3 2024, the 2024 Restructuring Plan was announced, subsequently approved and committed to by our management team, and initiated to implement cost-reduction measures, including reductions in employee headcount, other operating expenditures, and capital expenditures (see "Note 7: Restructuring and Other Charges" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements).

We expect that our 2024 Restructuring Plan, in conjunction with other initiatives, will reduce our cost structure while we continue our investments to develop, manufacture, market, sell, and deliver product and process initiatives in furtherance of our strategy.

peer_results.rationale: The primary restructuring disclosure for Micron (mu_2024_7_D004) concerns the 2023 Restructure Plan implemented in 2023, not a 2024 plan. While the plan's savings persisted into 2024, the charges ($171 million) and plan initiation occurred in 2023, making it not directly comparable to AMD's 2024 Restructuring Plan charges incurred in 2024.

NVIDIA's candidate disclosures (nvda_2024_7_D021, nvda_2024_7_D016) concern Automotive segment performance and general business scope, respectively. Neither disclosure mentions restructuring charges or restructuring plans for fiscal year 2024, rendering them not comparable to AMD's specific restructuring topic.

comparisons.peer_summary: Fiscal 2024 other expenses included $107 million in restructuring charges, mostly severance, and a $75 million charge for settling a securities class action lawsuit.
